pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large polygonal dark regions exhibiting high-frequency edge angularity, specifically toothed or leaf-like margins. Individual patches show sharp pixel-level gradients against the lighter interstitial spaces, with spatial area decreasing as the pattern moves towards the limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-pigmented negative-space network forming a continuous graph with frequent tri-directional and tetra-directional junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform on the central flank, narrowing towards the posterior and ventral regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette representing a short, dark mane along the upper neck and shoulder line.
